title: Coverage Policy Compiler
description: Compiles and enforces project-level code coverage policy. Enforces: global thresholds defined, branch ≤ lines (logically consistent), per-file thresholds for critical paths, anti-cheating checks (tests without assertions), fail-build configured.

error_codes.QA010: coverage-policy-spec.json missing or invalid — required: global thresholds (lines, branches, functions, statements)
error_codes.QA011: branches threshold exceeds lines threshold — logically impossible (branch coverage is always harder)
error_codes.QA012: Global threshold is below 60% or above 100% — unrealistic coverage target
error_codes.QA013: Test file contains it/test block with no expect() assertion — anti-cheating violation
error_codes.QA014: failBuildBelow is 'none' — coverage policy defined but not enforced
error_codes.QA015: per-file threshold glob does not match any files in the project
error_codes.QA016: Library/utility paths (src/lib, src/utils) do not have threshold above global
